title: Floer cohomology in the mirror of the projective plane and a binodal cubic curve
note: PDF library/arxiv-1109.3255v2/1109.3255v2.pdf — arXiv:1109.3255v2 [math.SG], stamped 13 Feb 2014; id year is the arXiv submission. Cited with a caveat: its 'twisting sheaf O(1)' is a FALSE COGNATE for the QOU twist `T_q` — Serre twist shifts a grading, `T_q` deforms the identity by an idempotent. What does connect is the ℤ-graded coordinate ring ⊕ H⁰(O(n)) as a template for where a grading on spectral-sequence pages could come from, which is the input `BarGradedCollapse` does not supply for the Gröbner filtration.
